# Strata Property Services

> stratapropertyservices.com — 13 trade divisions for strata and commercial properties, Lower Mainland BC. Est. 1989.

Full-service strata and commercial property maintenance across the Lower Mainland BC. Snow removal, roofing, plumbing, gas, electrical, painting, fencing and more.

## Services

- Snow Removal & De-Icing (PlowWow)
- Roofing
- Plumbing & Drainage
- Gas Fitting
- Electrical
- Painting & Decorating
- Fencing & Gates
- Steel Stud Framing
- Drywall & Ceilings
- Flooring
- Landscaping
- Concrete & Masonry
- General Contracting

## Service Area

Vancouver, Burnaby, Surrey, Richmond, Coquitlam, North Vancouver, Langley, Abbotsford, New Westminster, Delta, White Rock, Maple Ridge, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, Chilliwack
